name: Coherent Corp.
tagline: Leading provider of photonics and advanced electronics for AI datacenter and industrial applications
hero_kpi_rationale: Segment de croissance clé porté par la forte demande des clients hyperscale construisant des datacenters AI, utilisant les nouveaux produits transcepteurs ZR/ZR+ et les solutions de transport télécom traditionnel.

kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from communications products and services, including datacenter transceivers and telecom transport solutions
kpis.description: Revenue from datacenter transceivers, ZR/ZR+ transceiver products and traditional telecom transport solutions driven by hyperscale cloud customer AI datacenter construction.

stories_kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated in fiscal year 2025
stories_kpis.description: Total revenue for fiscal 2025 reflecting strong demand in Communications segment driven by AI datacenter buildouts

ai_positioning.summary: Coherent is a significant beneficiary of AI datacenter buildouts. The company experienced stronger demand throughout fiscal 2025 in its Communications market driven by hyperscale and cloud customers building AI datacenters. Strong demand for datacenter transceivers and new ZR/ZR+ transceiver products directly supports the AI infrastructure buildout.
evidence: Increased number of hyperscale and cloud customers building AI datacenters drove demand for datacenter transceivers
Strong demand for new ZR/ZR+ transceiver products from AI datacenter customers
Growing demand for telecom transport products supporting AI datacenter infrastructure
Focus on display and semiconductor capital equipment within Industrial segment supporting AI chip manufacturing

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cyberattacks and security incidents that could result in costly damages, claims, expenses, reputational harm, competitive disadvantage, or operational disruption. Board oversight through NCG Committee with quarterly briefings on cybersecurity risks and incidents. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Company is vulnerable to cybersecurity threats with potential for significant financial and reputational impact. Mitigated by dedicated Chief Information Officer and Global Head of Cybersecurity with combined 45+ years experience including 20+ years in cybersecurity.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in competitive markets where pricing and margin pressures could result from competing products and services. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Competitive market dynamics may impact pricing power and gross margins across Communications and Industrial segments.

risks.title: Geopolitical and Trade Risks
risks.score_rationale: US-China tariffs, trade sanctions, and rare earth mineral export restrictions could disrupt supply chain and increase costs. In 2025, significant new tariffs were implemented and retaliatory measures taken by multiple countries. China restricted exports of rare earth minerals used in company products. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Geopolitical tensions including US-China tariffs, trade sanctions, and rare earth mineral export restrictions present material risks. Diversified global manufacturing footprint and internal production capabilities provide some mitigation. However, sustained disruption in global trade could result in revenue reduction, cost increases, or production delays.

risks.title: Restructuring Plans
risks.score_rationale: Company approved multiple restructuring plans (2023 Plan, 2025 Plan, Synergy Plan) resulting in significant charges and operational disruption. Fiscal 2025 charges totaled 177 million dollars combined. Actual timing and costs may differ materially from estimates. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Ongoing restructuring activities including site consolidations, workforce reductions, and facility relocations may create operational challenges and cost volatility. Expected completion by end of fiscal 2026, but actual outcomes may differ materially.

risks.title: Asset Impairments
risks.score_rationale: Company recorded non-cash impairment charges of 85 million dollars in Q4 fiscal 2025 related to assets held-for-sale. Goodwill impairment risk exists if fair value determinations do not support carrying amounts due to cyclical business conditions. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Asset impairments including 85 million dollar charge on held-for-sale entities in Q4 2025. Goodwill impairment risk present given cyclical nature of business and potential for downturns in customer demand affecting reporting unit fair values.

risks.title: Macroeconomic and Cyclical Risks
risks.score_rationale: Company operates in cyclical markets with exposure to fluctuations in customer demand, capital spending cycles, and general economic conditions. Downturns in customer demand, operational challenges, and adverse macroeconomic conditions could materially impact profitability. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Business is subject to cyclical demand patterns and macroeconomic headwinds. While Communications segment benefited from AI datacenter buildouts in fiscal 2025, Industrial segment faced weak overall end-market demand. Future downturns could materially impact financial results.

governance.voting_structure: Une seule classe d'actions ordinaires, 1 vote par action.
